description: Figure 2 is a bar chart that compares the average accuracy of different training methods across 11 datasets. The vertical axis, labeled "Average Performance," ranges from 0 to 60 in increments of 10. The horizontal axis, labeled "Training Method," displays six categories: Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS. Each category is represented by a single bar. The bar for "Standard" is orange and reaches approximately 52. The bar for "Self-RAG" is a light brownish-green and is slightly taller, at about 53. The "FactTune" bar is a darker green and is slightly shorter than "Self-RAG," at approximately 51. The "CInGS (w/)" bar is blue and reaches about 54. The "CInGS" bar is the tallest, in a dark blue color, reaching a value of approximately 58.
